evals.prompt: Use ast-grep to rewrite `obj.val && obj.val()` to `obj.val?.()` in this TypeScript codebase.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs a scoped ast-grep search preview with an explicit language flag before any rewrite, inspects representative matches, and only then runs the rewrite command with the same explicit scoping.
assertions: Runs an ast-grep search/preview command before any rewrite command
Specifies --lang ts explicitly on both the preview and rewrite commands
Applies the rewrite only after confirming the preview matches the intended pattern
Reviews the resulting diff for unintended changes using the safety checklist before finishing
deterministic_checks: the preview/search run happens strictly before the rewrite/apply run

evals.prompt: Only in src/components/, replace `React.FC<Props>` type annotations with the plain function-with-Props-arg form using ast-grep.
evals.expected_behavior: Scopes the ast-grep command to src/components/ only, does not widen to the whole repository or add unrelated glob/language targets beyond what was asked, and previews before rewriting.
assertions: Command path scope is limited to src/components/, not the whole repository
Does not add unrelated languages or directories beyond what the user asked
Runs a single narrow preview rather than repeated broad scans before rewriting
deterministic_checks: command path argument is `src/components/`, not the repo root

evals.prompt: Write and apply an ast-grep rule file to convert `require(...)` calls to ESM `import` statements in this JS package, then show me the result.
evals.expected_behavior: Builds a rule file, previews it with `ast-grep scan --rule`, applies it only after a clean preview, and the final diff contains only the intended require-to-import structural edits with no unrelated formatting churn.
assertions: Produces a rule file used with `ast-grep scan --rule`
Final diff contains only require-to-import edits, no unrelated formatting changes
States explicit exclusions for generated/vendor/build directories
Summary states matched scope and any rollback/retry decisions

evals.prompt: Find every occurrence of the exact string "TODO: remove after migration" in this repo.
evals.expected_behavior: Treats this as plain literal string search and uses a direct rg/glob search instead of building an ast-grep structural pattern or invoking the ast-grep workflow.
assertions: Does not construct an ast-grep pattern or rule file for this request
Uses a direct rg/text search tool instead

evals.prompt: I have a failing test after a merge and don't know why it's broken — can you find the root cause?
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to systematic-debugging instead of treating this as an ast-grep search or rewrite task, since the main work is root-cause failure analysis, not structural code search.
assertions: Does not propose ast-grep commands as the primary approach
Routes toward root-cause debugging methodology (systematic-debugging) instead
